WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
4. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON PRESENTATION ITEM NO. 5.1, CLOSED SESSION ITEM 6.1, AND NON-AGENDA ITEMS:
5. PRESENTATION:
5.1 Emergency Management presentation by Los Angeles County Fire Chief Tom Sullivan, Sheriff's Department Captain Ron Shaffer and Palmdale Emergency Services Coordinator Chiniforoushan. (Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
PowerPoint Presentation for Item 5.1
6. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
6.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding possible litigation which the City may enter as an amicus curiae ("friend of the court")
Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of the
University of California
United States Supreme Court
Docket No. 18-587
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.9 & 54956.9(d)(4).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case.
7. CLOSED SESSION.
8. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
9. ADJOURNMENT.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Mayor Hofbauer called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3.
ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
PRESENT:
Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Juan Carrillo, Richard J. Loa.
ABSENT:
None.
4.
PUBLIC COMMENTS ON PRESENTATION ITEM NO. 5.1, CLOSED SESSION ITEM 6.1, AND NON-AGENDA ITEMS:
Public Comments: None.
5.
PRESENTATION:
5.1
Emergency Management presentation by Los Angeles County Fire Chief Tom Sullivan, Sheriff's Department Captain Ron Shaffer and Palmdale Emergency Services Coordinator Chiniforoushan. (Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Emergency Services Coordinator Chiniforoushan presented a PowerPoint presentation and provided Council with an overview of the City's Emergency Management plan. Los Angeles County Fire Chief Sullivan and Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department Captain Shaffer provided Council with an overview of their departments and services.
Council spoke regarding City Council receiving formalized Emergency Preparedness and evacuation training.
Director of Administrative Services Ambrose spoke regarding communication efforts.
There was further Council discussion regarding training and Emergency Preparedness.
6.
PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
City Attorney Ditzhazy stated that the item would be heard as listed.
6.1
The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding possible litigation which the City may enter as an amicus curiae ("friend of the court")
Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of the
University of California
United States Supreme Court
Docket No. 18-587
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.9 & 54956.9(d)(4).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case.
7.
CLOSED SESSION.
Closed Session was held from 8:30 p.m. - 9:05 p.m.
8.
ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
The Mayor and All City Council Members were present.
Item 6.1 CC – Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of the University of California / United States Supreme Court – In closed session the City Council was advised of the request by the Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights LA (CHIRLA) for amicus brief participation in the Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of the University of California matter before the US Supreme Court. Council provided unanimous direction to the City Attorney. No further reportable action at this time.
9.
ADJOURNMENT.
Mayor Hofbauer adjourned the meeting at 9:15 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 1st day of October 2019.
_______________________
Steven D. Hofbauer, Mayor
